governing_intent: Prove an offline, event-driven continuous-factory walking skeleton with deterministic test doubles, durable restart recovery, priority/dependency/WIP scheduling, automatic refill, custody enforcement, and no provider spend or Node change.
summary: PY-04 is bounded and executable without inventing Founder or architecture decisions. SWF-12 resolves the previously material local-artifact custody question; PY-03 implementation remains a sequencing dependency, not a readiness gap.
implementation_unknowns: Concrete WorkManagement and WorkerProvider port signatures and typed outcome shapes.
Fixture format, coordinator process entrypoint, run-summary schema, and SQLite transaction sequencing through PY-03.
Implementation of the fresh-process artifact retrieval, digest read-back, and deterministic verifier observation path within SWF-12.
Concrete retention-policy injection and test fixture behavior without inventing a new retention policy.
verification_assessment: The acceptance criteria require real executable proof: coordinator-path tests using deterministic doubles, an actual SQLite-backed process restart, custody positive and negative cases, policy-evidence negative cases, priority/FIFO/dependency/WIP/refill assertions, and a no-repeated-read assertion. These tests exercise the real application boundary rather than mocked coordinator internals.
material_risks: The current checkout is on main but is not clean and is ahead of origin/main; implementation must begin from the contract-required released clean baseline.
PY-02's custody guard must remain active; a scripted success or missing/failed independent read-back must not reach VERIFY or ACCEPT.
PY-04 must not absorb PY-06 production worktree, remote-publication, or source-control custody mechanics.
The scripted worker must remain test infrastructure and not be represented as SF-REQ-039 capability.
next_action: After PY-03 is accepted and a clean released main baseline is available, release PY-04 for implementation and execute its acceptance suite.
rationale: Priority ownership, release ON/OFF semantics, lifecycle ownership, no-polling, WIP, recovery, port direction, budget constraints, and offline local-artifact custody are all fixed by binding authority. SWF-12 explicitly authorizes the local content-addressed artifact path and requires its fresh-process digest verification before VERIFY. Remaining choices are normal implementation detail inside those constraints, and the coordinator plus its necessary offline proof infrastructure form one coherent decision center.
